t_advice_summary_textbox.text: At first it seemed to be based on colour choice.  Then it seemed that the colour of the basket made a difference.  In the end it's just a game.  Go with it and enjoy.

vb_textbox.text: At first, I was choosing the colour of the gnome but I didn't find this helpful.  After some time, if the reward was shown as 5X, I chose the gnome to the right which seemed to win a lot of points.  Other than that, just enjoy the game.
